plain_text:
NOTE! After one minute of inactivity, an Auto Log Out countdown will display next to the

Logout button, and the system will log the user out if no activity has taken place by the time
the countdown runs out (see fig. 9). To remain logged in, an action will need to take place, such
as clicking within the APR, saving, or navigating to a different page. It is recommended to save
often to avoid losing data.
